title: Bezel Charts: charts that look finished the moment you add them

scenes.title: Bezel Charts
scenes.subtitle: Charts that look finished the moment you add them
scenes.narration: Meet Bezel Charts: charts that look finished the moment you add them.

scenes.quote: I wanted charts that are fully customisable and easy to drop into any project, and a way to give something back to the developer community.
scenes.narration: It started with a simple wish: customisable charts that drop into any project, and a way to give back to the developer community.

scenes.heading: Born in London
scenes.narration: Bezel Charts was born in London.

scenes.caption: One tag. One finished, labelled, animated chart.
scenes.narration: Every chart is a single HTML tag. Add one line to any page, and you get a finished, animated chart.

scenes.label: for all sixteen charts, gzipped
scenes.narration: All sixteen come to about twenty-six kilobytes, with no dependencies.
Version one launched with ten charts. Two weeks later, there were sixteen.
Track change over time, like sixteen releases in three weeks.
Rank anything, like the world's highest mountains.

chart.heading: Countries with the most coral reef

scenes.narration: Show how a total splits, like the countries with the most coral reef.

chart.heading: Indonesia's share of the world's coral reefs

scenes.narration: Or one reading at a glance, like Indonesia's share of the world's reefs.

scenes.heading: Yours to style
points: Any colour, one per bar or series
Light and dark themes that follow the viewer
Rounder or squarer corners, framed or not
Numbers and dates in any language
Works with a keyboard and a screen reader
scenes.narration: Style it your way: any colour, light or dark, numbers in any language, from English and French to Persian and Japanese. And it works with a keyboard and a screen reader.

scenes.heading: Where to get it
points: The Studio: build one with no code
scenes.narration: Get it on npm, or on PyPI for Python. Or build one in the Studio, no code needed.

scenes.title: Try Bezel Charts
scenes.narration: Try it, share what you build, and open an issue if anything isn't quite right.
